prompt.en: You see a crime taking place. What does Discover Canada say you can do?
prompt.fr: Vous êtes témoin d'un crime. Que dit le guide Découvrir le Canada que vous pouvez faire?

options.en: Take the person to court yourself.
options.fr: Traduire vous-même la personne devant le tribunal.

options.en: Do nothing, because only lawyers may report a crime.
options.fr: Ne rien faire, car seuls les avocats peuvent signaler un crime.

explanation.en: Witnessing a crime is one of the situations where you can turn to the police for help.
explanation.fr: Être témoin d'un crime est l'une des situations où vous pouvez vous adresser à la police pour obtenir de l'aide.

source.quote: You can ask the police for help in all kinds of situations—if there’s been an accident, if someone has stolen something from you, if you are a victim of assault, if you see a crime taking place or if someone you know has gone missing.

verification.evidence: You can ask the police for help in all kinds of situations—if there’s been an accident, if someone has stolen something from you, if you are a victim of assault, if you see a crime taking place
